text: Hino e ɓen wonɓe sera saare Madiina nden, jeyaaɓe e yimɓe ladde ɓen, naafiqiiɓe, hino e yimɓe Madiina ɓen kadi naafiqiiɓe ñiiɓuɓe tabiti e naafiqaaku. An Nulaaɗo, a anndaa ɓen, ko Alla woni ko anndi ɓe. Meɗen fawii leptugol ɓe laaɓi ɗiɗi : laawol ka aduna, ɗum wona huncugol naafiqaaku maɓɓe wara ɓe daha, laawol ngola woni ka laakara, gila ga lepte qabri, refti ɓe ruttoyee Ñalnde Darngal faade e lepte mawɗe ka koose Yiite.
